title: Dissoluble
summary: DISSOLUBLE, adjective [Latin See Dissolve.] 1. Capable of being dissolved; that may be melted; having its parts separable by heat or moisture; convertible into a fluid. 2. That may be disunited.

inlines.v: DISSOLUBLE, adjective [Latin See Dissolve.] 1. Capable of being dissolved; that may be melted; having its parts separable by heat or moisture; convertible into a fluid. 2. That may be disunited.
